waypoints.name: SR-20 Wine Spires pullout (milepost 166)
waypoints.note: Roadside pull-off on SR-20 near milepost 165-166, ~4 mi east of Washington Pass; cross Early Winters Creek then climb ~3 mi to Burgundy Col.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the unsigned Wine Spires pullout east of Washington Pass, near milepost 165-166 at about 4,300 feet — a plain roadside pull-off roughly 4 miles east of the pass. There is no sign, so watch your mileposts. This is the parking for the whole Wine Spires group; the climbers' path toward Early Winters Creek and Burgundy Col leaves straight from the shoulder.

waypoints.name: The Ledge Bivy
waypoints.note: Common bivy area partway up to Burgundy Col.

waypoints.name: Burgundy Col
waypoints.note: Separates the Wine Spires from Vasiliki Ridge; Vasiliki Tower stands on the left entering the col.

waypoints.name: Vasiliki Tower
waypoints.directions: Vasiliki Tower stands on the left (north) side as you enter the col. From the col, scramble up broken ground to the system of right-trending dihedrals on the tower's sunny south face and follow them for two pitches to the summit.
